title: 3.1.0 White Theme Problems
body:
When using Light Theme on a Pixel 5 App crashes and can't be restarted.
Keeps on crashing and AAPS doesnt open again

comments.body:
What version before updating?
Try a clean install and reimport your settings.

Came from 3.0.0.1 

clean installation tried but no solution.
app keeps crashing when switching to light theme
If you install it clean without import settings and than switch to white theme it also crashes ?

That’s very strange .
You can send a logfile and maybe write me in messenger for further discussion if you want

Can confirm same behavior on a OnePlus 3. [Logfile here](https://www.dropbox.com/s/z7c83n4br1erjz0/AndroidAPS.log?dl=0).  
The logs start around 20:16, v3.0.0.1 is still installed and everything works fine.

At 22:35:52.073, v3.1.0 has been installed and boots for the first time. All good.  
Around 22:40:52, the theme is set from dark mode to light mode. AAPS goes into a loop: crash, reboot, crash, reboot, ...

At 22:48:20.731 is me force installing my old apk of version 3.0.0.1. AAPS reboots and works normally again.
Can confirm same behavior on a OnePlus 8 Pro. Already downgraded, so sadly no logfile. Ping me in Discord if I can add something to the issue.
